title: Book 4: Ad Astra, Hard Reset & The Stadium Years (1995–2004)
description: Recording Cassidy's four-movement magnum opus 'Escape Velocity (Ad Astra)' in 1995, buying back the band's entire catalog after the 1996 lottery windfall, job-shadowing Holly O'Connell through a sixteen-hour day as Band Manager and General Counsel in 2002, and writing 'Before the Distance' on Progress Street NE in 2004.
